product_family: GTM (Go-to-Market) Intelligence Platform for B2B revenue teams. Core products: RevvyAI (conversational AI assistant), 6sense Ads (intent-driven advertising), AI Email Agents, Revenue Marketing suite, and Sales Intelligence. All powered by proprietary Signalverse data with 13 years of B2B intent signals and per-customer predictive models.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Undergoes annual independent third-party audit covering all five Trust Service Criteria: Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, and Privacy. Auditor: Schellman & Company, LLC.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: 6sense maintains SOC 3 certification alongside SOC 2 Type 2.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification maintained through annual independent third-party audit. Meets internationally recognized Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) standard. Auditor: Schellman & Company, LLC.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: 6sense achieves ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification for Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS), a globally recognized standard focused on AI governance, risk management, and ethical use of AI.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Fully compliant with GDPR. Maintains renewed TRUSTe GDPR Validation certification. Participates in UK-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks (DPF). As a data processor, implements policies and procedures addressing consent, data subject rights, incident response, DPIAs, and vendor management as required by GDPR.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: Compliant with California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). Achieved TRUSTe CCPA Validation through TrustArc LLC.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement support on vendor's trust center, terms of service, or support documentation.

certifications.name: CSA AI Trustworthy Pledge 2025
certifications.proof_quote: 6sense has committed to the Cloud Security Alliance AI Trustworthy Pledge 2025, demonstrating commitment to responsible AI practices.

certifications.name: EcoVadis Sustainability
certifications.proof_quote: Maintains EcoVadis commitment through February 2026, demonstrating commitment to sustainable business practices.

privacy.ai_training_note: 6sense explicitly trains predictive models on customer data to identify accounts and buying group members most likely to convert. Models are trained on decade-plus B2B purchase decision patterns. Per privacy policy, Subscriber-Provided Information is processed 'at the Subscriber's direction' under data processing agreements. De-identified and aggregated data may be used for product improvement and analytics.
privacy.data_region: US-based company with international operations. EU/UK/Swiss data transfers governed by Data Privacy Framework certifications.

security.name: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
security.value: Dedicated CISO with teams across incident response, vulnerability management, secure SDLC, continuous monitoring, threat hunting, vendor risk management, customer assurance, and enterprise risk management.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual independent penetration testing conducted by CREST-accredited vendors.

security.name: Infrastructure & Availability
security.value: AWS-hosted infrastructure with redundant, multi-system architecture for high availability.

security.name: AI Security Controls
security.value: Dedicated secure AI development lifecycle with model risk assessments, LLM penetration testing (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs), input validation, output filtering, and continuous monitoring.

security.name: Privacy Governance
security.value: Privacy co-managed across executive oversight (CFO, CTO, CLO) and engineering-level implementation with dedicated privacy leadership.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Not explicitly stated in publicly available documentation.

products.name: RevvyAI
products.data_scope: Operates on account context, buyer signals, intent data, and activity. Trained on customer data.
products.notes: Flagship product providing instant intelligence to revenue teams. Uses per-customer AI models to reason on account data.

products.name: 6sense Ads
products.data_scope: Targets on live buying intelligence and intent signals, not static lists.
products.notes: Intent-driven advertising platform powered by proprietary Signalverse data.

products.name: AI Email Agents
products.data_scope: Generates and sends personalized emails grounded in real-time buyer signals and customer data.
products.notes: Automates email generation and reply handling. Operates on buyer signal data.

products.name: Revenue Marketing Suite
products.data_scope: Integrates first-party CRM, MAP, and web data with third-party intent signals.
products.notes: Omnichannel workflow engine for campaign orchestration across ads, email, web, and sales.

products.name: Sales Intelligence
products.data_scope: Provides real-time account and contact data, buying signals, and predictive insights.
products.notes: Per-customer AI models resolve signals into explainable, cited intelligence.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription (per-product and platform-wide tiers). Specific pricing not disclosed publicly.
compare.data_residency: US-based infrastructure with AWS, DPF-certified for EU/UK/Swiss data transfers.

flags: HIPAA not supported: Despite appearing in some third-party compliance comparison tools, 6sense does not publicly claim HIPAA compliance. Not listed in trust center, terms, or support docs. No BAA offering mentioned.

AI training on customer data is integral to product: Predictive models are trained on customer data by design. This is properly governed via DPA and GDPR compliance, but not suitable for regulated healthcare or HIPAA-covered entities.

Third-party signal collection: Platform combines customer data with proprietary Signalverse data (intent, job changes, funding) scraped from public web and data brokers. Customers must ensure their use complies with GDPR/CCPA and fair use principles.
B2B-only platform: Terms explicitly restrict to business-to-business use. Not intended for HIPAA, healthcare, or consumer financial services applications.
